race.comment: Tricky race to assess with a few of these facing the starter for the first time. Of the raced brigade DR KNOW (4) was well in the market at Kembla on debut and hit the frame after sitting up on the speed. Gets Lloyd on top from the inside marble and should play a role in the outcome. The well-related SAFFRON VEIL (6) (half to G1 winner Communist) has finished runner-up in both outings to date and looks to be on the doorstep of a maiden victory. Top-three candidate. AFFARI (9) has placed three from three around this circuit and will be ready to peak now third run back from a spell. In the mix. CALOOCAN BEAUTY (12) returns from a spell after racing just once to date when fourth at Randwick over 1000m. Recent trial form is very strong including a win at the latest appearance at Warwick Farm. Watch for any market confidence.
